executiveSummary: A deadly earthquake in Tibet killed at least 16 people, injured 54, collapsed hundreds of homes, and disrupted communications and highway access. View Article Powerful earthquakes in Panama triggered nationwide evacuations, damage across all provinces and Indigenous territories, and temporary airport disruption; international assistance was mobilized. View Article Supporting Report Torrential rain in eastern Spain killed four people, isolated multiple towns, forced over 2,000 evacuations, and left about 87,000 residents under shelter-in-place orders. View Article Severe flooding and storms across the U.S. Four Corners swamped at least 80 homes and 50 RVs in Utah, caused evacuations in Colorado, downed power lines in Arizona, and resulted in injuries. View Article Wind-driven wildfires in coastal Southern California forced about 16,000 evacuations and damaged or destroyed at least six homes; Santa Ana winds sustained ongoing risk. View Article Photo Report Cross-border flooding in Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay displaced thousands, including more than 2,000 people in Ayolas, Paraguay; river levels also restricted access near Iguazu Falls. View Article IFRC activated or updated operations for multiple crises: Ethiopia's drought response, Nepal floods, and southern Myanmar flood/landslide impacts requiring targeted assistance. IFRC Appeal Operations Update Response Overview Regional tropical systems contributed to fatalities and infrastructure disruption along Mexico's Pacific coast, while separate typhoon warnings shuttered airports and harbors in Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands.
